_comment: Daily caps — updated 2026-06-23 after ledger audit. The OLD budget.json tracked the harbor-master fleet (filleting/deboning/canning). The NEW botnet uses workers in botnet/workers/. Caps below apply to BOTH codepaths; the tripwires are the ones that matter.
_context: As of 2026-06-23: team runs 24/7 on HF Space (zerocool69/kiripedia). GH Actions cron is disabled (schedule: block commented out in botnet-cycle.yml). Only workflow_dispatch remains for manual one-offs. finalize-ingest.yml and x-poster.yml (8 slots/day) are still active on GH Actions.

youtube_trawler._note: Title-based filtering is rule-based, not LLM. No fleet calls at sea.

web_trawler._note: Web results need LLM triage. worker_fast (Groq Llama 3.1-8b) only.

filleting._note: Legacy harbor-master label; new botnet equivalent is scribe.mjs (Groq).

deboning._note: Legacy label; new equivalent is cataloger-editor.mjs (Cerebras).

canning._note: Legacy label; new equivalent is coordinator.mjs (Cerebras).

new_botnet_roles._note: Estimated per-cycle LLM call counts based on role design. Actual call volume is near-zero today because discovery is dead (6 leads in DB, all at 'lead' status, none reach cataloger/reviewer).

tripwires._rationale: Old limits (500/1500) were set for the harbor-master plan with 14 parallel bots. Current team is running 24/7 but with near-zero actual LLM calls (discovery dead, pipeline starved). Realistic limit for steady state (post-fix): ~50-100 LLM calls/day for enhancement workers on existing 279 articles. Backfill surge (once Channel Crawler is live): up to 800/day using 4 Cerebras keys + 2 Groq keys in rotation.

free_tier_capacity.cerebras_per_key_per_day: ~1000 calls (rate-limit inference; no published daily cap, empirical)
free_tier_capacity.groq_llama70b_per_key_per_day: ~1000 calls (empirical; hard limit not published for free tier)
free_tier_capacity.kiripedia_keys: 4 Cerebras + 2 Groq = ~6000 Cerebras calls/day + ~4000 Groq calls/day theoretical ceiling before rotation exhaustion

escalation_to_opus._note: Airlocked per BOTNET-HANDOFF §4. These quarantine with reason; nobody is paged. No Opus spend in steady state.
